card_text: Growing a modern mullet from Hobbs: how to space the shaping trips, and when color makes the drive pay.

seo.title: Modern Mullet for Hobbs, NM | Divinely Faded, Carlsbad
seo.description: Modern mullet and burst fade mullet for Hobbs, cut in Carlsbad 70 miles west. A mullet is grown over several trips; how to plan them, plus platinum color.

paragraphs: Tight faded sides, a textured top and honest length in back. I cut modern mullets in Carlsbad; from Hobbs it's {{city:hobbs.route}} the whole way, {{city:hobbs.drive_mi}} miles and about {{city:hobbs.drive_min}} minutes by OpenStreetMap routing.
A mullet is grown as much as it's cut, so from Lea County it's a project spread over several trips. This page is about spacing them.

blocks.heading: Several trips, one tail.
paragraphs: Starting from short hair, the back needs months to clear the collar while the sides stay tight. Each shaping visit is another {{city:hobbs.drive_min}} minutes each way, so I'd rather space them out than see you every time the fade softens: let the sides go a little looser and come in when the back needs its shape corrected.
Once the tail is where you want it, the sides set the pace again.

blocks.heading: Platinum turns the drive into a day.
paragraphs: If you want the platinum version on the main mullet page, the Color Transformation runs {{minutes:color-transformation}}. Add the cut and you've filled most of an afternoon, the kind of appointment that justifies a {{city:hobbs.drive_mi}}-mile trip. Text {{phone}} before booking cut and color together so I can block the time in one piece.

blocks.heading: Cut, beard, bleach.
blocks.lead: Prices and times come from my Booksy menu.

items.title: Essential Haircut
items.body: Sides faded, back shaped, top textured, with a straight razor along the neck and a finished style. Also the booking for a burst fade mullet.

items.title: Signature Cut
items.body: The mullet plus your beard, trimmed or lined up, and a hot towel. A full beard balances the length in back.

items.title: Color Transformation
items.body: Bleach and tone to platinum or the shade you have in mind. Its own service, its own block of time.

items.q: How many trips from Hobbs does growing a mullet take?
items.a: Depends on your starting length. From a short cut, expect a few shaping visits while the back catches up; we'll map them out at the first one.

items.q: Can I get the cut and the platinum color on one trip?
items.a: Yes, if you text me first so I can book the two back to back. Plan on the better part of an afternoon.

items.q: Where can I see both versions?
items.a: The modern mullet page has the platinum one and the dark, curly burst fade mullet.
